title: Understanding Exponential Regularization
text: Exponential regularization tends to increase the penalty on larger parameter values as lambda increases. This can lead to increased bias in the model.

title: Effect of Lambda on Bias
text: As lambda increases, the regularization term becomes more dominant, which can cause the model to underfit the data, leading to increased bias.

title: Identifying the Correct Plot
text: Look for a plot where the bias increases as lambda increases. The increase should be steep and unbounded, reflecting the exponential nature of the regularization.

hintAnswer: B: bias increases as lambda increases, growing steeply and unboundedly
title: Choosing the Correct Plot
text: Which plot shows bias increasing steeply and unboundedly as lambda increases?
choices: A: bias decreases then levels off as lambda increases
B: bias increases as lambda increases, growing steeply and unboundedly
C: bias decreases monotonically as lambda increases
D: bias increases then decreases as lambda increases
E: bias remains constant as lambda increases
